_comment: Domain fields a search or get tool's item leaves out. Read by tests/contract-parity.test.ts (item parity). Since 2026-11-20 the item carries every field of the {Entity}Domain the tool answers with: a field the backend serializes and the contract omits never reaches the public reference or an agent, and until that day this half of the gate was a warning that pnpm test does not print. Each entry is a decision, per tool, naming the ruling or the research section that keeps the field out. The stricter gate's first run (2026-11-20) found 21 tools leaving out 28 Domain fields; they were put on their items the same day, and the one entry left is a ruling. An entry that stops applying (the tool is gone or no longer checked, its item carries the field, the Domain lost it) FAILS the gate, so this list can only shrink. Regenerate the oracle (pnpm oracle:refresh) before touching it.

_keys.tool: The tool name, exactly as the registry has it.
_keys.fields: The Domain fields its item leaves out, as the oracle names them.
_keys.nullable: The Domain fields typed nullable with no default (null by design) that its item states as never null.
_keys.reason: Why: the ruling or the research section that decided it, or 'debt:' for a gap nobody decided.

orchestration.reason: Ruling, research webhook_logs.md Domain (2026-09-12): a delivery to an integration sink names sink_ref and no webhook_sid, and sink rows are the integration's, never listed to the team's users or agents. The team's search reads WebhookLogService's base query, whereNull('sink_ref') (orchestration d0c2679), so every row it answers has a webhook_sid and no sink_ref.
